title: NEW MSFS Activities This Week! ✈️ Fly Caribbean Nights + WWII Market Garden Missions (PC Update)
description:
Another exciting week in the Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update for February 7, 2026! This week brings a strong lineup of must‑have activities, including the stunning Caribbean Nights adventure pack and several immersive Perfect Flight Captain Collections for the A320 and 747.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Koschi: Caribbean Nights – Nicaragua, Honduras, Guatemala, Belize (Caribbean regional exploration pack)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 747 Captain - Virgin Atlantic (Long‑haul airline missions)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain Master Collection (Airline operations experience)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Above the Sky Master Collection (High-altitude scenic flying)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: History by Air WWII Operation Market Garden (Historical war mission pack)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – ASA [Winter 2025] (Airline timetable activity)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – CCA [Winter 2025]
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – ETD [Winter 2025]
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – EZY [Winter 2025]
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline Schedules – JST [Winter 2025]
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – EGCC [Winter 2025]

🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – OTHH [Winter 2025]

If you enjoyed the video, don’t forget to drop a like, hit subscribe, and tell me in the comments which of these new activities you’re flying first!

✈️ See you in the skies!
